Will caching make my edits show late?
We tune caching so edits show promptly. Drupal clears cache for changed content automatically, and we test with your editors' normal tasks before we finish.
Do you rewrite my page content?
We fix titles, descriptions and headings. Rewriting article text is separate. For key pages, we suggest improvements you can approve.
